```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidypopgen)
library(resrepo)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- path_resrepo("results/s08_FIS/")
```

## Load gt

```{r}
malagasy <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
```

# Population level FIS

Calculate FIS for each Malagasy population.

```{r}
fis <- malagasy %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  pop_fis(method = "WG17", by_locus = FALSE, include_global = FALSE, allele_sharing_mat = NULL)

# create dataframe for plotting
fis <- as.data.frame(fis)
fis$population <- rownames(fis)

# rearrange fis column fis in descending order
fis <- fis[order(fis$fis, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Reorder the population variable as a factor based on the descending order of FIS
fis$population <- factor(fis$population, levels = fis$population)
```


# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(fis, aes(x = population, y = fis, fill = population, colour = population, shape = population)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  labs(title = expression("Population specific F"[IS]), x = NULL, y = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)")) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 3, 4, 8)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    colour = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Population")
  )

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "pop_fis.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


# Population level FIS for Merina subsets

```{r}
# Load fastmixture Q matrix
qmats <- readRDS(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData"))
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))
```

```{r}
# tidy with the gt
tidyq <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1), data = mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

```{r}
# subset to only malagasy
all_malagasy <- c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Diego", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro")

malagasyq <- tidyq %>% filter(population %in% all_malagasy)
```

```{r}
# subset the malagasyq dataframe to only the "Merina"
merina <- malagasyq %>% filter(population == "Merina")

# plot column .Q3 for the merina
ggplot(merina, aes(x = .Q3)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(y = "Count of Individuals") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "merina_q3.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

# Separate the two Merina clusters according to ancestry proportion

```{r}
# create column $group in merina - those with .Q3 higher than 0.5 are 1 and those lower than 0.5 are 2
merina$group <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "Social group A", "Social group B")
```

# Calculate FIS for Merina groups separately

This time, grouping merina by the new column $group.

```{r}
fis_merina <- merina %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  pop_fis(method = "WG17", by_locus = FALSE, include_global = FALSE, allele_sharing_mat = NULL) #

# change fis_merina to a dataframe and make a column $population corresponding to group
fis_merina <- as.data.frame(fis_merina)
fis_merina$population <- rownames(fis_merina)
colnames(fis_merina) <- c("fis", "population")

# add fis_merina to fis
fis <- rbind(fis, fis_merina)

# rearrange fis column fis in descending order
fis <- fis[order(fis$fis, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Reorder the population variable as a factor based on the descending order of FIS
fis$population <- factor(fis$population, levels = fis$population)
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(fis, aes(x = population, y = fis, fill = population, colour = population, shape = population)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  labs(title = expression("Population specific F"[IS]), x = NULL, y = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)")) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 3, 4, 8, 2, 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    colour = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Population")
  )
```

Here, we can see that Merina Social group A has a higher Fis value than Social group B.

# Inspect sample sizes

```{r}
table(malagasy$population)
table(merina$group)
```

Sample size may be having an impact...?

# Individual FIS

```{r}
malagasy <- malagasy %>% ungroup()
malagasy <- malagasy %>% mutate(fis_indiv = indiv_inbreeding(malagasy, method = "WG17"))
```

```{r}
# plot $F for each individual IID coloured by FID
ggplot(malagasy, aes(x = population, y = fis_indiv)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = population)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)"), fill = "Population") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "indiv_fis_grouped.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
# create a column $total_count to count the number of individuals in each group
total_count <- table(malagasy$population)
malagasy$count <- total_count[malagasy$population]

# add total_count number to the top right corner of each facet plot
ggplot(malagasy, aes(x = fis_indiv, fill = population)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~population) +
  labs(y = "Count of Individuals", x = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  geom_text(
    data = malagasy %>%
      distinct(population, count), # Extract unique population and count
    aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("Total Individuals: ", count)),
    size = 3, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  )


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "indiv_fis_hist.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

# Run glm

```{r}
glm(malagasy$fis_indiv ~ malagasy$population)
```


```{r}
identical(malagasy$id, malagasyq$id)
identical(malagasy$population, malagasyq$population)

malagasy$.Q1 <- malagasyq$.Q1
malagasy$.Q2 <- malagasyq$.Q2
malagasy$.Q3 <- malagasyq$.Q3

# now plot $.Q3 vs inbreed_df$F
ggplot(malagasy, aes(x = fis_indiv, y = .Q3, fill = population, shape = population, color = population)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  labs(title = "F"[IS] ~ " against ancestry proportion for Malagasy individuals", x = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)"), y = ".Q3 proportion (% Asian ancestry)") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 3, 4, 8)) +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    colour = guide_legend(title = "Population"),
    shape = guide_legend(title = "Population")
  )


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "indiv_fis_vs_q3.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# Run glm

```

## Recalculate individual FIS in tidypopgen, this time separating the inferred social groups

```{r}
# subset malagasy to those with population "Merina"
merina <- malagasy %>% filter(population == "Merina")

# create a factor
merina$group <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "Social group A", "Social group B")

merina <- merina %>% group_by(group)

merina_fis_indiv <- merina %>% indiv_inbreeding(method = "WG17")


merina_fis_indiv <- unlist(merina_fis_indiv)
merina_fis_indiv <- as.data.frame(merina_fis_indiv)
merina_fis_indiv$id <- rownames(merina_fis_indiv)

merina <- left_join(merina, merina_fis_indiv, by = "id")
```

```{r}
ggplot(merina, aes(x = group, y = merina_fis_indiv)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = group)) +
  labs(y = expression("F"[IS] ~ "(Weir and Goudet 2017)"), x = NULL, fill = "Social Group") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "indiv_fis_merina_grouped.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
